  {"step":5,"file":"src/sfnt/ttcmap.c","function":"tt_cmap4_set_range","line":706,"var":"cmap->cur_values","code":"offset ? p + offset : NULL","note":"Format-4 cmap range data is decoded from the font and a pointer into the cmap table is computed from attacker-controlled offsets."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/sfnt/ttcmap.c","function":"tt_cmap4_next","line":768,"var":"cmap->cur_values / cmap->cur_charcode","code":"advance through cmap ranges and read glyph indices from cur_values","note":"Iteration over the cmap range consumes the computed pointer and can step past the valid table when the cmap data is malformed."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/sfnt/ttcmap.c","function":"tt_cmap4_char_index","line":455,"var":"glyph index","code":"return glyph index from cmap lookup","note":"The malformed cmap lookup returns a glyph index that drives later glyph loading and exposes the out-of-bounds state."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/sfnt/ttgload.c","function":"TT_Load_Glyph","line":null,"var":"glyph slot bitmap/outlines","code":"load glyph using the cmap-derived glyph index","note":"The corrupted cmap-derived glyph index reaches the glyph loader, which performs the memory-safety sink and triggers the heap-buffer-overflow write."}
]
print(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
